svg.title: Cabin A cutaway: walls cut at 1.2 m, viewed from the south-west
svg.desc: Axonometric cutaway of Cabin A: The Retreat with the roof removed and walls cut 1.2 m above the floor, showing Sleeping, Living, Kitchenette, Bathroom, furniture, the envelope layers in the cut walls, screened porch, ramps and piles. Concept only.
svg.text: Original concept | CC BY 4.0 | Eco Hamlet contributors 2026 | Concept only, not for construction
